material.acceptance_criteria: A CI run panics the mod thread once and logs one mod_thread_died and one mod_thread_restarted, and a later mod edit still bumps the served version.
material.description: The supervision CI job forces only a ticker panic. The mod thread is supervised (mods.rs supervise call) but no CI run panics it, so its death and restart are unwitnessed. Add a test-only mod-thread panic trigger and assert ev=mod_thread_died and ev=mod_thread_restarted, then the mod reload still works.
material.resolution: A test-only flag panics the mod thread once. The supervisor logs ev=mod_thread_died, restarts the thread reopening the mod from its captured image, logs ev=mod_thread_restarted, and a later mod edit still bumps the served version. Printed: mod thread panic ok died=1 restarted=1 version_after=2.
material.subject: Witness a mod thread panic and restart in CI
